collection.title: Audi S7 2012 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi S7 2012 - 2018 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
